description.value: The OV Arts Centre is a City of Nanaimo-operated cultural facility listed under the municipality's Cultural Spaces & Facilities program. It serves as a dedicated arts venue within Nanaimo's broader parks, recreation, and culture portfolio. Touring cyclists exploring Nanaimo's cultural offerings may find it a worthwhile stop, though specific visitor amenities are not documented in available sources.
